s.note: Chopped prawns, capsicum, celery and thyme in a crisp Bahamian fritter batter, with lime and pink sauce
s.how: Chop 400g peeled raw prawns. Whisk 150g plain flour, 1 tsp baking powder, salt, an egg and 125ml milk into a thick batter and stir in the prawns, half a diced green capsicum and onion, a diced celery stick, a chopped chilli and a tsp of thyme. Fry spoonfuls in oil at 180C for 3 to 4 minutes until golden. Serve with mayonnaise mixed with tomato sauce, chilli sauce and lime.

s.note: Crisp carrot, cucumber, radish, celery and capsicum sticks with green herb yoghurt dip
s.how: Blitz 200g Greek yoghurt, 2 tbsp mayonnaise, a bunch each of parsley and chives, half a bunch of basil, the juice of a lemon, a garlic clove and salt until green and smooth, then chill for 30 minutes. Cut 2 carrots, 2 cucumbers, 4 celery sticks and a red capsicum into sticks, trim a bunch of radishes and crisp in iced water for 10 minutes. Drain and serve around the dip.

m.n: Palmyra grilled lobster tails with Bahamian baked macaroni
m.note: Split lobster tails grilled with garlic, lime and paprika butter, with Bahamian baked macaroni and cheese
m.how: Cook 300g macaroni until almost done. Whisk 2 eggs, a tin of evaporated milk, 200g grated tasty cheese, diced capsicum and onion, cayenne, salt, pepper and 20g melted butter, stir in the pasta, top with 50g more cheese and bake at 180C for 40 minutes. Melt 80g butter with 3 garlic cloves, a lime's zest and juice and paprika. Split 4 lobster tails lengthways, brush with the butter and grill for 6 to 8 minutes, basting, until just opaque. Serve with the macaroni and parsley.

w.n: Nassau guava duff with rum butter sauce
w.note: Steamed Bahamian roly-poly swirled with spiced guava, sliced and covered in warm rum butter sauce
w.how: Rub 60g butter into 250g flour, 2 tsp baking powder, salt and 2 tbsp sugar, add an egg and 125ml milk and roll out to 25 x 30cm. Spread with 250g guava paste warmed with water, cinnamon and nutmeg, roll up, wrap in buttered paper and foil and steam for 75 minutes. Melt 80g butter with 100g brown sugar, bubble with 80ml cream and stir in 2 tbsp dark rum. Slice the duff and pour over the sauce.

d.note: Coconut rum with pineapple, orange and lime over ice, dark rum floated on top
d.how: Stir 120ml coconut rum, 360ml pineapple juice, 60ml orange juice and 30ml lime juice in a jug. Pour over ice in 4 tall glasses, float 30ml dark rum on each and garnish with pineapple and a cherry.
